plugins.name: worktree-guidelines
plugins.description: Guidelines-first worktree workflow: entry steers you to load a per-language guidelines skill (or ask to build one via best-practices) and code via the coder agent, which uses Context7 for up-to-date library docs.

plugins.name: session-manager
plugins.description: Adds commands to manage a session in the project, /start-session to start a session and /summarize-session to summarize the session and update the summary.md file.

plugins.name: image-generator
plugins.description: Generates images via OpenRouter using Vertex AI models. Triggers on /generate-image or automatically when an image is needed.

plugins.name: project-organizer
plugins.description: Initializes and maintains an Obsidian vault inside the project directory that serves as a living knowledge base of the project's structure, features, tools, and dependencies.

plugins.name: oogabooga
plugins.description: A fun plugin that adds a command /oogabooga to make the AI start talking like a caveman. Useful to reduce Token usage

plugins.name: project-planning
plugins.description: Reads a project's plan.md and builds/updates a tasks.md split into Milestones and sub-tasks with descriptions and a status tracking table. Auto-triggers at project/session start so the planning convention never needs re-explaining.

plugins.name: environmental-preparations
plugins.description: A running log of the user's environment preferences and configuration changes (CLAUDE.md rules, settings, conventions). Read at session start to set up the environment the way the user likes.

plugins.name: coding-guidelines
plugins.description: Coding guidelines bundle — invoke the matching -guidelines skill BEFORE writing code for that stack (frontend, backend, containerization, ci-cd). Encodes per-stack conventions, architecture rules, and tooling commands.

plugins.name: packaging-software
plugins.description: Invoke BEFORE writing any PyInstaller .spec file or packaging a Python app into a Windows .exe. Encodes onedir build, .spec-driven config, icon/logo, exe naming + embedded version metadata, and frozen-app asset bundling.

plugins.name: rtl-fix
plugins.description: Mod: displays Hebrew/Arabic (RTL) text correctly in your messages and Claude's replies, wrapping lines before reordering them.

plugins.name: usage-alert
plugins.description: Mod: shows 5-hour and weekly usage in the status line and alerts when either reaches 90%.

plugins.name: idle-handoff
plugins.description: Mod: warns before an idle session's prompt cache expires, saves a handoff summary (on idle, /exit or /clear), and offers it to the next session in the project.
